SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No: B. REGISTRY. No. D 4856 Date 13 / 3 / 34）
Date March 13, 1934.

Subject (in full) G. P. Yastreb.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [签名]

George P. Yastreb, by profession an artist in oils
and water colours, a Russian who during and after the Russian
revolution served as an officer with the White Russian Army
and came to Shanghai in 1924. He is married and has three
children and at present is residing at No. 54 Haskell Road.
Yastreb has been variously employed in Shanghai since his
arrival, except for a few months in 1926 when he made a trip
to Harbin on business. At one time he owned a picture shop
on Seymour Road but failed after only a few months operation.
For the past two years he has been connected with
the Shanghai Art Advertising and Illustrating Company, No.19
Museum Road, and has as a partner one K.C. Yew, a Chinese,
who is reputed to be fairly wealthy.
The subject of this report is known to many of the
Russian members of the S.M.P. and is given the character of
being a hard working and honest individual not likely to be
involved with any dubious undertaking.

[签名]
D. S. I.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号：B. 登记处。编号 D 4856 日期 1934年3月13日）
日期：1934年3月13日。

主题（全称） G. P. Yastreb。

由 特别处副督察长 Golder 制作 转呈 [签名]

George P. Yastreb，职业为油画和水彩画画家，俄国人，在俄国革命期间及之后曾在白俄军队中担任军官，于1924年来到上海。他已婚，育有三名子女，目前居住在 Haskell Road（音译）54号。Yastreb 自抵沪以来在上海从事过各种工作，除了1926年有几个月因公务前往哈尔滨外。他曾一度在西摩路（Seymour Road）拥有一家画店，但仅经营数月便倒闭。在过去两年里，他一直与位于博物院路（Museum Road）19号的上海美术广告插图公司（Shanghai Art Advertising and Illustrating Company）有关联，其合伙人是一位名叫 K.C. Yew 的华人，据称相当富有。
本报告的对象为上海公共租界工部局警务处的许多俄籍成员所熟知，其品格被评价为勤奋诚实，不太可能卷入任何可疑活动。

[签名]
特别处
副督察长。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, MARCH 12, 1934

AN ALBUM OF SHANGHAI
Editor, THE SHANGHAI TIMES
Sir,—We herewith enclose a copy of a letter the original of which has been forwarded to the Lord Mayor of Greater Shanghai.
We would esteem it a great favour if you will kindly publish the same in your valuable journal.
G. P. YASTREE,
General Manager,
Shanghai Art Advertising
and Illustrating Co.
Shanghai, March 10, 1934.
March 8, 1934.
General Wu Teh-chen,
Mayor of Great Shanghai,
Shanghai.
Dear Sir,—It affords us great pleasure in thanking you for accepting our invitation to dinner on the second anniversary of this Company, which was held in the Paramount Ball Room on February 17, 1934.
May we reiterate here that, in the near future, this Company will publish an album, which will be an embodiment and personification of Shanghai and which will include art pictures in every page.
During the dinner on behalf of the Company, our Mr. Quinnell had announced to the guests present that upon the request of Professor Hwang Ho-ching, the Company had gladly agreed to contribute 25 per cent. of any net profit which might accrue from the sale of this album towards furthering the education of poor students of the universities of Shanghai, and that this fund would be forwarded in due course to the Commissioner of Education of Greater Shanghai.
Under these circumstances, we, the undersigned, find it necessary to write to your goodself this letter of confirmation of Mr. Quinnell's announcement as above mentioned.
Copies of this letter have been forwarded to the Commissioner of Education and to the Foreign and Chinese Press.
With best regards and hoping that in publishing this album, we will have your hearty support and co-operation.
Very respectfully yours,
G. P. YASTREE,
Director & General Manager.
K. C. YEW,
Director and Manager.

上海美术广告
插图公司
上海，1934年3月10日。
1934年3月8日。
吴铁城将军，
大上海市长，
上海。
尊敬的先生，——本公司谨就阁下接受邀请出席本公司成立两周年晚宴一事，致以诚挚谢意。该晚宴于1934年2月17日在百乐门舞厅举行。
我们在此重申，本公司将于近期出版一本相册，该相册将是上海的化身与体现，每一页均包含艺术图片。
在代表公司举行的晚宴上，我们的 Quinnell 先生向在场宾客宣布，应黄浩清（Hwang Ho-ching，音译）教授之请，本公司欣然同意将该相册销售所得净利润的百分之二十五捐出，用于资助上海各大学贫困学生的教育，该款项将适时汇交大上海教育局局长。
鉴于上述情况，我们以下签署人认为有必要致函阁下，以确认 Quinnell 先生的上述声明。
本信函副本已分送教育局局长以及中外报界。
顺致最良好的祝愿，并希望在本相册出版过程中，能得到阁下的鼎力支持与合作。
此致
敬礼
G. P. YASTREE，
董事兼总经理。
K. C. YEW，
董事兼经理。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. P. S. B. REGISTRY
File No. D 4156
S. I., Special Branch, Shanghai
REPORT
Date May 9, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Art Advertising and Illustrating Co.
- publishing of the "Shanghai Daily Advertising Bulletin".

Made by D.S. Sanson Forwarded by Theo Robertson, Supt.

The attached letter, dated May 3rd, 1933, from
Mr. G. Yastreb, Russian, manager of the Shanghai Art
Advertising and Illustrating Co., 24 Nanking Road, informs
the S.M.C. that the said company is compiling a daily
advertising bulletin, known as the "Shanghai Daily
Advertising Bulletin". The purpose of the letter is
to ascertain whether such publication is subject to
registration with the S.M.C., as in the case of the
French Municipal Council. Mr. Yastreb has been
informed verbally that the S.M.C. does not exercise any
form of control over such publications and that there is
nothing to prevent him from publishing his bulletin,
providing, of course, that same conforms with the laws of
the country to which he is subject.

The verbal reply has been accepted by Mr. Yastreb,
thus obviating the necessity of a literal reply.

D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
C. D. J. Bruce,
Please note and pass
to Registry to file.
9/5
MAY 9 1933

上海 特别处 高级督察
报告
日期：1933年5月9日。

主题（全称） 上海美术广告插图公司
- 出版《上海每日广告公报》。

由 特别处副督察长 Sanson 制作 转呈 Theo Robertson 警司

附件为1933年5月3日来自 G. Yastreb 先生（俄国人，上海美术广告插图公司经理，地址南京路24号）的信件，通知上海公共租界工部局，该公司正在编纂一份每日广告公报，名为《上海每日广告公报》。去信目的是查明此类出版物是否像法公董局辖区那样需要在上海公共租界工部局注册。已口头告知 Yastreb 先生，上海公共租界工部局对此类出版物不实行任何形式的管制，只要该公报符合其所属国家的法律，他即可出版，没有任何阻碍。

Yastreb 先生已接受该口头答复，因此无需书面回复。

特别处
主管警官。
C. D. J. Bruce，
请知悉并转交
登记处归档。
5月9日
1933年5月9日
